submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 16 (Al0.21Sb0.79) had the highest EQE at 2.1 eV: 0.011%, compared with -0.0012% at index 10 and 0.0006% at index 20. All values are very low, which fits wide-gap Al/Sb oxides under sub-gap illumination. XRD showed the same two peaks (Q≈2.78 and 4.54 Å⁻¹) in every scan, probably from the substrate. Weak rutile-type AlSbO4-like peaks appeared near 50% Sb, but that composition (index 10) gave no photoresponse.

rejected.reason: The rutile AlSbO4-like phase is present, but EQE was about zero (-0.0012%).
The most Sb-rich end had lower EQE (0.0006%) than index 16.
Al2O3-dominated, so insulating and wide-gap. XRD showed only a weak secondary peak. Not measured.
